source: The important word is reuse. If a value is fetched from device memory and used once, the hierarchy has little opportunity to amortize that movement. If the same value can be used dozens or hundreds of times while it remains on chip, a relatively expensive transfer can feed a large amount of computation.
zh: 重要的词是重用。如果从设备内存中获取一个值并使用一次，则层次结构几乎没有机会分摊该移动。如果相同的值可以在芯片上使用数十或数百次，则相对昂贵的传输可以提供大量计算。
